EV-03.name: Expedited return is the cheaper option

raw.text:
WAREHOUSE SUMMARY: WH-BCN, 84% occupancy (at-risk), 1 container reviewed, 1 at risk, 0 escalated, 800 EUR total exposure at stake

CONTAINER: L-5533
CARRIER: Leviatán Lines
CONTAINER TYPE: 20DRY
DAYS LEFT: 8
COUNTS: 2 containers within 2 days of expiry (P-2041, L-5518); threshold 5; NOT MET. Free move slots on 2026-08-04: 1 of 4 (P-2044, L-5522, P-2048 already booked).
OPTIONS: accept overrun 6 days = 500 + 900 = 1400 EUR; expedite = 500 + 100 = 600 EUR; extension 6 days = 500 + 150 = 650 EUR; CHEAPEST: expedite 600 EUR.
RISK: AT RISK
STATUS: OK
RECOMMENDATION: Expedite the return at 600 EUR
RATIONALE: Expedite costs 600 EUR and brings the container back before expiry. Extension would cost 650 EUR, saving nothing. Accepting the 6-day overrun costs 1400 EUR, 800 EUR more than expediting.
